gaps.explanation: Detail revenue is the p16 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - Total Primary Government (one combined schedule for governmental and utility funds). Governmental-tagged lines: Property Taxes 86,391 + Federal Receipts 54,575 + Pro-Rate 213 + Highway Allocation and Incentive 95,128 + Motor Vehicle Fees 6,997 + Municipal Equalization 31,444 + State Other 138,116 + Motor Vehicle Taxes 7,416 + Local Option Sales Tax 141,149 + In Lieu 0 = 561,429; statement p7 Total column 640,101; gap 78,672. The p7 rows that have the same amount on p16 (86,391, 213, 31,444, 94,528 + 600 = 95,128, 6,997, 7,416, 141,149 = 368,738) tie; the other p7 rows (271,363: Franchise 1,900, Homestead 8,516, Property tax credit 5,647, Fees 1,868, Grants 143,750, Building Rent 15,931, Park 4,301, Pool 2,769, Farm income 28,521, Interest 5,566, Donations 10,182, Miscellaneous 42,412) are carried on p16 by Federal Receipts 54,575 + State Other 138,116 (192,691) and, for the rest, inside the single printed primary-government line 'Local Receipts: Other' 1,412,104 (detail index 10, tagged business-type because it is mostly utility charges); Federal Receipts 54,575 in turn includes the Water Fund Grant Proceeds 44,778 (p12). 271,363 - 192,691 = 78,672. One printed line cannot be split, and the governmental fund columns (General, Street, Airport, Community Development) are on the left-hand statement page (printed p22) that the Auditor's PDF does not contain; the visible p7 columns (Community Center 8,056, Medical Center 6,150, Keno 0) are already inside the primary-government schedule, so adding them would double count. No fix.

p17 budget schedule Governmental disbursements: General Government 94,143 + Public Safety 96,283 + Public Works 222,821 + Public Health and Social Services 1,947 + Airport 79,433 + Culture and Recreation 133,257 + Community Development 117,299 = 745,183 (cash budgetary basis, capital outlay inside the functions). Statement p8 Total 689,866. Difference 55,317 = the p8 third other-financing row (50,000) (Total column only; Community Development 117,299 budget vs 67,299 statement) + 5,317 that the budget counts as disbursements while the p8 Adjustments column prints (5,317) / 5,317 on the transfer rows (Total 35,000 / 0). 689,866 + 50,000 + 5,317 = 745,183. Printed basis difference; the p8 fund-column cells for these rows are on the missing left-hand page (printed p24). No fix.

p16 'Transfers In' 40,517 (detail index 11) is a primary-government gross figure; p8 Total column transfers in 35,000 is net of the Adjustments column (5,317). 40,517 = 35,000 + 5,317 (governmental interfund transfer the p8 Adjustments column eliminates) + 200 (p12 Sewer Fund 'Transfers' 200, business-type). One printed line; not split. No fix.

The only business-type-tagged revenue detail line is the p16 primary-government 'Local Receipts: Other' 1,412,104 (detail index 10, cash budgetary basis), which mixes utility receipts with governmental local receipts. Statement (pp11-12 fund columns, Totals): Total Operating Revenues 1,219,364 + Grant Proceeds 44,778 + Interest Income 3,866 = 1,268,008. Gap -144,096 = governmental receipts inside the same printed line (see governmental revenue) less the Water grant 44,778 carried in the governmental-tagged Federal Receipts line, plus cash receipts the statements do not report as revenue (63,561 equals the p8 fourth other-financing row, Total column; the remaining amount is not identifiable from the trim). The p11-12 Electric / Water / Sewer / Sanitation revenue cells would tie to the statement, but adding them while index 10 stays would count the utility charges twice, and index 10 cannot be removed: it is not a pure duplicate (it also holds governmental money) and a printed line is never split. No fix.

p12 Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds, row 'Transfers': Electric Fund (35,200), Water Fund 0, Sewer Fund 200, Sanitation Fund 0, Adjustments 0, Totals (35,000) = business_type.transfers_net. Electric (35,200) is in no detail line (the p17 budget 'Electric' line is no longer in detail; the Electric detail lines are the p11-12 fund-column lines). Added as Transfers Out -35,200 (printed row 'Transfers', negative). Not added: Sewer 200, because the same 200 is already inside the p16 'Transfers In' 40,517 (detail index 11; 40,517 = 35,000 + 5,317 + 200). After the add, detail business-type transfers -35,200 vs -35,000; the 200 difference is that Sewer amount held in index 11 (tagged governmental). No transfer line is labelled the wrong way round.
